office_does: The County Clerk is clerk of the Okanogan County Superior Court, filing and keeping its records, dockets, orders and judgments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Clerk Susan Speiker (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County Clerk since 2023 and former chief deputy clerk; 2025 Clerk of the Year of the state county clerks' association; the only candidate.
highlights: Clerk since 2023; with the county since 2009 [S1]
Named Clerk of the Year by the Washington State Association of County Clerks in 2025 [S1]
